code_description: Fused QKV + F.scaled_dot_product_attention (FlashAttention) + FP16 autocast + is_causal

BF16 compute (weights pre-cast to bf16, RoPE cached as bf16) + torch.compile(mode=max-autotune-no-cudagraphs) for inductor fusion + inline RoPE (no rotate_half helper) + reshape (skip contiguous) + cuDNN-only SDPA backend + no autocast wrapper + no final dtype cast. Skips autocast overhead and lets compile fuse matmuls directly in bf16.
